scientific.integrity: The proof uses the source's exact stage probabilities and stopping-time representation, derives the asymptotic exponent analytically, and uses finite dynamic programming only as corroboration.
scientific.limitations: This is an exact large-deviation law for one specified adaptive single-copy stabilizer-learning algorithm. It does not establish optimality among all adaptive protocols, improve the fixed-confidence leading copy constant, or cover tolerant learning.

title: Exact reliability exponent and a bottleneck transition for adaptive single-copy stabilizer learning
